notes.title: Merry Christmas! Update 0.44 is now available!
notes.notes:
🎄✨ Merry Christmas! 🎅✨
We’re thrilled to bring you a new update packed with fun and surprises. Here’s what’s new in version 0.44 of Ragdoll Universe!

🗺️ New map for Challenge Mode (1 player):
"Anomaly": Dive into a mysterious hotel inspired by memory and investigation games. Discover and resolve anomalies to escape the loop. Will you rise to the challenge?

🗻 New map for Versus Multiplayer Mode:
"Snowy Mountain": Compete with your friends on the peak of a snowy mountain filled with Christmas spirit. Only the last elf standing will earn Santa’s favor. HOHOHO!

🔧 Minor tweaks and improvements:
Small fixes and adjustments to keep the experience smooth and exciting.

Once again, thank you for your support and we wish you all Happy Holidays. See you in the game! 🎮

notes.title: # Update 0.43
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After a short break following the launch, we’re diving into the exciting journey of periodic updates. My goal is to deliver weekly updates, and while this first one may not include a large amount of new content, there’s a good reason for it: I’m focusing on improving the game’s programming, experimenting, and testing new mechanics to provide a more diverse and enjoyable experience.

Update 0.43:

New map in Challenge mode: Street Of Ragdoll
New map in Challenge COOP mode: Hold Out
New map in Versus mode: Game of Death
New reward available in the SHOP REWARDS: RaceTrack
Other small tweaks and improvements.
Thank you for your continued support. This is just the beginning of what’s to come!

notes.title: Devlog #2 | Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello again to all the followers of my game!

I'm excited to announce that the game will be released next Friday, the 25th. During this time, I've been working hard on new mechanics, maps, and overall improvements to offer you the best possible experience. I've also been organizing the roadmap for future updates and realized how important it is to launch the game at this early stage. I need your feedback to know what you enjoy the most and where I should focus my development efforts.

New Features and Improvements
Split-Screen Local Multiplayer: I've implemented split-screen, opening up a world of possibilities for game modes and map distribution in local multiplayer.

Passengers on Vehicles: It's now possible for passengers to board the vehicles included in the game. This adds a new layer of strategy and fun, as you can cooperate or compete while driving.

New Maps

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/5dc2b01aa2e682884ed9f013277464888514691f.png

Temple: A local multiplayer map featuring pillars that descend toward lava at intervals. You'll need to grab onto vines to avoid falling. Will you be brave and wait until the last moment fighting before grabbing on, or will you hold on as quickly as possible, exposing yourself to attacks from your opponents?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/5de9cb494d28baa29f851bbe2eee64cbb359511a.png

Shark Cave: Escape from a shark while battling against other players. There's a cage that protects you from the shark, but it's small and not everyone fits. Characters can now swim, which allows me to create future underwater maps and zones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/e969574c1da7b3ff264464cbead4f919bbb8a481.png

Ruins: Designed to debut the split-screen mode, this map is set in an area of very similar ruined buildings, making it hard to tell where you're being shot from. Watch out for surprises!

Next Steps
I'm continuing to improve various aspects of the game and plan to incorporate Steam services like achievements and Steam Workshop. I'll also add more maps, game modes, and, most importantly, implement skin customization.

I'm eager to hear your opinions and suggestions. Your feedback is essential to help me focus development on the areas that interest you most.

Thank you for your continued support and for being part of this adventure! See you on Friday the 25th.
